purpose: Proactive discovery, enrichment, and watchlist lifecycle management for Trade AI agents.

dividend_core.description: Dividend income or dividend growth candidates

swing_trade.description: Momentum and technical setups for swing trades

compounder.description: Longer-term compounder candidates with analyst/news support

research_queue.description: Ideas found from user transcripts, web/social references, or incomplete data needing review

notes: This config is safe to edit later, but the installer does not require manual edits.
Provider calls are best-effort. Missing API keys are logged, not fatal.
The pipeline writes JSON state first, then optional Postgres tables. No trades are executed.
